The main content includes a list of players whose salaries have increased since they last played, along with their respective teams, new salaries, and the amount of the increase. The players listed are:

3. Serge Ibaka, PF/C (TOR) - $6100 (+$600)
4. Harrison Barnes, SF/PF (DAL) - $6300 (+$400)
